summary: Throttled force-feedback state logger. Reads the current session time (dbl_8AFEA0), and when the delta since the last logged event (field 0x1018) exceeds 0.125s it compares the previously stored 18-byte FF snapshot (fields 0x101C..0x102C) against the live force-feedback state returned by ForceFeedback(this+0x6E4). On mismatch it stores an event via ProgressBarEventEncode into a ring buffer (dword_8AAE64, count dword_83EE60) and records the new snapshot. When the delta exceeds 4.0s it force-logs the current FF state without a comparison. Both paths select an event code of 6 or 18 from a zero-test on the FF state and pass the object id (field 0x4) plus session time as payload.

local_names.v25: current session time float from dbl_8AFEA0
local_names.v31: local 16-byte stored FF state snapshot from fields 0x101C..0x1028
local_names.v26: first dword of live FF state returned by ForceFeedback
local_names.v27: second dword of live FF state
local_names.v28: third dword of live FF state
local_names.v29: fourth dword of live FF state
local_names.v18: event-kind test: no second-dword byte2 and no third dword set

operations.description: Debounce gate: proceed only when delta >= 0.125; otherwise do nothing this call.
Branch on delta <= 4.0: inside = compare-and-log path; else = forced flush path without comparison.
Build an 18-byte stored-state snapshot into local buffer from fields 0x101C (dword), 0x1020, 0x1024, 0x1028 and 16-bit field 0x102C.
Call ForceFeedback(this + 0x6E4) to obtain the current 18-byte force-feedback state pointer.
Copy the live state from the returned pointer: four dwords at +0/+4/+8/+12 and a 16-bit word at +16 into locals v26..v30.
Word-wise comparison loop (9 iterations) of stored snapshot vs live state; stops at the first mismatch.
Log only on mismatch: if the stored and live states are equal, no event is written.
Ring buffer advance: if dword_83EE60 < 1023 then increment dword_83EE60 and add 432 to the write pointer dword_8AAE64.
Event-kind selection: code 6 when byte2 of the second live dword and the third dword are both zero, else code 18.
Call ProgressBarEventEncode(ring_ptr, 2, 2, kind, *(DWORD*)(this+0x4), dbl_8AFEA0, 0) to encode the event header with the object id and session time.
Write the 18-byte live state payload (v26..v30) into the ring slot at ring_ptr+8..ring_ptr+24.
Forced-flush path: update last-event timestamp this+0x1018 = dbl_8AFEA0.
Ring buffer advance: if dword_83EE60 < 1023 then increment dword_83EE60 and add 432 to the write pointer dword_8AAE64.
Call ForceFeedback(this + 0x6E4) to obtain the current force-feedback state pointer.
Write the live state directly into the ring slot at +8 (dword), +12, +16, +20 and +24 (word) with no prior comparison.
Event-kind selection for flush path: code 6 when byte at slot+14 and dword at slot+16 are both zero, else code 18.
Call ProgressBarEventEncode(ring_ptr, 2, 2, kind, *(DWORD*)(this+0x4), dbl_8AFEA0, 0) to encode the flush event header.
